note: Official names, descriptions and grades as PlayStation publishes them, cross-checked on Exophase and PSNProfiles (18 Nov 2026). Guides are this entry's own words. All 55 trophies are offline and single-player; there are no online trophies. The whole list can be earned in a single playthrough in roughly 200-250 hours. Cheats disable trophies and saving, so leave cheats off for a trophy run.

stages.title: Play the story
stages.text: Chapters 1-4 and the final mission. Story trophies unlock as you play and cannot be missed — missions can be replayed.

stages.title: Side stories & exploring
stages.text: Contact and stranger strands, collectibles and one-time moments as they appear. Start the collectibles early and mind the one flagged missable.

stages.title: Activities, challenges & money
stages.text: Shooting ranges, stunts, races, challenges and the money trophies. The long grinds live here.

stages.title: Cleanup & platinum
stages.text: 100% completion last — it needs 300 stunts and 70 of 80 challenges — then the platinum pops on its own.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: Earn the other 54 trophies and this unlocks by itself. Budget roughly 200-250 hours for the full list; the longest tail is 100% completion, not the story.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Complete the opening mission, Gone Fishing. It unlocks naturally at the start of the story and cannot be missed.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 1. Story progress only — finish the chapter's missions in order and it pops at the chapter's end.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 2. The asterisks are part of the official trophy name as PlayStation publishes it. Story progress only.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 3. Story progress only — it unlocks when the chapter's final mission ends.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 4. Story progress only — the last chapter before the finale.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Complete the final story mission. This is the last story beat — finish the story and the gold pops with it.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Complete the mission Breakfast Run. A story mission — it unlocks when the mission ends and can be replayed from the mission menu.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Complete the mission The Cartel Heist. A story mission — it unlocks when the mission ends.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Complete the mission Child's Play. A story mission — it unlocks when the mission ends.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Complete the mission Headliners. A story mission — it unlocks when the mission ends.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Complete the mission VCIA Takedown. A story mission at the airport — it unlocks when the mission ends.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Complete the mission Operation Savage Glory. A story mission — it unlocks when the mission ends.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Attain 100% completion — the in-game checklist opens after the story. The long tail is 300 stunts (the trophy itself needs 250) and 70 of the 80 challenges, plus every collectible. Save this for last; most lists call it the hardest trophy in the game.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunts of any kind — stunt jumps, flights under bridges, knife flights and base jumps. PowerPyx counts 397 stunts across Leonida, and 100% completion needs 300, so keep going past 250 rather than stopping at the pop.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once: fishing, hunting, golf, shooting ranges, pool, basketball, a video game, a race and a stunt. One try each is enough — you do not need to win any of them.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. Learn each range's layout first, then chase gold one challenge at a time. Most lists rank this the hardest trophy after 100% completion.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location — 14 in all. You only need one win per location, not every race at each spot. Learn the drone's handling on the first course, then work through the map.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Any race type counts; 20 distinct race events. Pick the vehicle classes you drive best and repeat wins there first.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Find Cal's fishing challenge and out-fish him — better bait and a steady reel win it.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete an arcade game. Play any arcade machine through to the end of a game — finishing is what counts, not the high score.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Andy. Finish Andy's mission strand; his last mission unlocks this. Strands can be done after the story.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Kenton. Finish Kenton's mission strand; his last mission unlocks this.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Billy. Finish Billy's mission strand; his last mission unlocks this.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across Leonida. Only some side questlines count, and PowerPyx is still confirming which — prioritise stranger missions as they appear on the map, and you can finish them after the story.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Randy. Finish Randy's mission strand; his last mission unlocks this.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Tyrone. Finish Tyrone's mission strand; his last mission unlocks this.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every spot across Leonida — 18 spots. GTABase and PowerPyx flag this as the only trophy that might be missable, so meditate at every spot you find as you go, and do not leave the last ones until after the story. If a spot will not trigger, try it at a different time of day.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Follow Bret's hunting strand to the unique animal and take it down — track it, do not spook it.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 Collectible Card sets out of 18. Collect cards across Leonida — shops, missions and hidden spots all hold them; any 3 complete sets count.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: WAiNK It at 100 locations. Tag 100 WAiNK spots as you explore; work through districts one by one and tick them off here so you know what is left.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 challenges — 50 of the 80 challenges in the game. 100% completion needs 70, so this comes on the way to A Long Road; chase the easy challenges first.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat. Get to 4 stars with your partner beside you, then break line of sight — alleys and tunnels help — and stay hidden until the stars clear.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level. Chain three shop robberies with your partner; keep the wanted level alive between them by staying visible to the law, and plan a fast car for the getaway after the third.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Drive or enter 100 distinct vehicles; new discoveries count as you find them around Leonida — variety beats mileage.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Group enemies first — a tight spot with several hostiles — trigger Combat Focus, and drop 5 before it ends.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA — leave the airport in a way the schedule did not plan. The description points to a scripted airport moment; the exact trigger is still being confirmed by players, so try the runway and the terminal routes.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Kinda hot in these Rhinos — take on the Rhino tanks. Expect a heavy wanted-level fight; bring explosives and cover, and keep moving so the cannon cannot track you.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Go in quiet — no alarms, no witnesses spotting you. Case the store first, move when the clerk looks away, and leave before anyone raises the alarm.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 Bank Vaults and escape. Five vault jobs, each ending in a clean getaway — plan the escape route before you crack the vault, and keep a fast car close.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an Armored Truck and escape. Hit a truck on a quiet stretch of road and get away before backup arrives.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida. Visit every area of the map; the in-game stats track your coverage, so sweep the map district by district and check the stats when a region feels done.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang. Hit one illegal operation per gang across Leonida — each gang's territory holds its own operation.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Order a cocktail at a bar spot overlooking Ocean Beach and take in the view — the trophy pops once the drink and the view come together.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. The description points to a scripted showroom escape — get in a car inside the showroom and drive out through the glass.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley. Bowl a game at the Kolt & Associates alley — finish the game and it pops.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: A partnership with mass appeal — a story-adjacent partnership moment. The exact trigger is still being confirmed by players, so keep playing the partnership content and watch for it.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Choices made, for better or worse. Make choices across the story and side content — the count behind this one builds up as you play, so do not rush past the decision points.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Second time's the charm. The description suggests a retry-based trigger — succeed on a second attempt where the first failed. The exact method is still being confirmed by players.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: What the hell just happened? A hidden trophy with an unconfirmed unlock method — players are still working out what triggers it. Keep an eye on the strangest corners of Leonida.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by. Knock someone down with a melee attack from a moving vehicle — the precise method is still being confirmed, so try a slow drive-by with a bat.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Launder marked bills through your contacts until the $250,000 total is reached — it accumulates across jobs, so keep every marked bill moving.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Shop spending accumulates across every store; big purchases count fastest, so save the expensive buys for this push.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase all garage properties — all eight purchasable garages. Buy each one as you can afford it; they also give you somewhere to keep the collection for Whip It Good.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Register ten vehicles you own or find through the Scooter Bros app — any ten count.
